author: Cezar Suceveanu
attribution: Photo: Cezar Suceveanu, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Piazzale_della_Stazione_din_San_Marino8.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
